claims: According to psychologist Robert Sternberg's triangular theory of love, love is composed of intimacy, passion, and commitment.
According to psychologist Robert Sternberg's triangular theory of love, Romantic Love is Intimacy + Passion.
According to psychologist Robert Sternberg's triangular theory of love, Companionate Love is Intimacy + Commitment.
According to psychologist Robert Sternberg's triangular theory of love, Fatuous Love is Passion + Commitment.
According to psychologist Robert Sternberg's triangular theory of love, Consummate Love is a mix of all three.
BetterPlace Health describes stages of relationships as Attraction, Infatuation, Courtship, Intimacy, Engagement, Disillusionment, and Commitment.
A Facebook video by Will Smith notes that understanding includes knowledge of the other's traumas.
Simple English Wikipedia notes that affection is demonstrated in both feelings and actions.
The NIV Bible highlights that love is patient, kind, and not self-seeking.
